scope: Headless Edge / Vite / Node bridge with passive Python trace and a shadow of the ecafbff display clock on identical delivered views and sample times. Shadow sampling adds CPU overhead; this is a latency diagnostic, not a throughput benchmark. JSON-string mode serializes the same response and parses it in the browser instead of Playwright object transfer; it is NOT a native Tauri measurement. Full click time starts at the browser click event. Canvas means render submission, not native/GPU completion. All latencies are wall milliseconds.
